package contracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/contracts"
	rs "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/jsonrpc/contracts/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	audit struct {
		t        *testing.T
		sends    atomic.Int32
		receives atomic.Int32
		opens    atomic.Int32
	}
	service struct {
		done chan struct{}
	}
	fakeStream struct {
		operation string
		ctx       context.Context
		err       error
	}
	contextKey struct {
	}
)

func TestMountedWebSocketOperations(t *testing.T) {
	a := &audit{t: t}
	implementation := &service{done: make(chan struct{})}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	rs.Mount(mux, rs.New(implementation.HandleStream, svc.NewEndpoints(implementation, a), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, &websocket.Upgrader{}, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{}))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	conn, response, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws"+strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "http")+"/ws", nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	if response != nil {
		require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
	}
	require.NoError(t, conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(3*time.Second)))
	require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"value":"input"},"id":"one"}`)))
	for _, want := range []string{"input:received:notification:sent", "input:received:response:sent"} {
		_, body, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Contains(t, string(body), want)
	}
	require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"value":"error"},"id":"two"}`)))
	_, body, err := conn.ReadMessage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, string(body), `"error":`)
	require.Contains(t, string(body), `"id":"two"`)
	require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
	select {
	case <-implementation.done:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("stream handler did not finish after peer disconnect")
	}
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.sends.Load())
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.receives.Load())
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.opens.Load())
}

func TestWebSocketOperationContextAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("operation failed")
	for _, name := range []string{"notification", "response", "error", "close"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			a := &audit{t: t}
			stream := &fakeStream{err: sentinel}
			ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "operation")
			endpoint := svc.WrapWatchEndpoint(func(_ context.Context, raw any) (any, error) {
				s := raw.(*svc.WatchEndpointInput).Stream
				value := "x"
				switch name {
				case "notification":
					return nil, s.SendNotification(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
				case "response":
					return nil, s.SendResponse(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
				case "error":
					return nil, s.SendError(ctx, sentinel)
				default:
					return nil, s.Close()
				}
			}, a)
			value := "x"
			_, err := endpoint(context.Background(), &svc.WatchEndpointInput{Payload: &svc.WatchPayload{Value: &value}, Stream: stream})
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
			require.Equal(t, name, stream.operation)
			if name != "close" {
				require.Same(t, ctx, stream.ctx)
			}
		})
	}
}

func (a *audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, "contracts", info.Service())
	require.Equal(a.t, "Watch", info.Method())
	switch info.CallType() {
	case loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv:
		value, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		payload := info.ServerStreamingPayload(value)
		payload.SetValue(payload.Value() + ":received")
		a.receives.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	case loom.InterceptorStreamingSend:
		result := info.ServerStreamingResult()
		result.SetValue(result.Value() + ":sent")
		a.sends.Add(1)
		return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	default:
		a.t.Errorf("unexpected call type %v", info.CallType())
		return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	}
}

func (a *audit) Observe(ctx context.Context, info *svc.ObserveInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, info.CallType())
	a.opens.Add(1)
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}

func (s *service) HandleStream(ctx context.Context, stream svc.Stream) error {
	defer close(s.done)
	for {
		if err := stream.Recv(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}

func (s *service) Watch(ctx context.Context, p *svc.WatchPayload, stream svc.WatchServerStream) error {
	if *p.Value == "error:received" {
		return stream.SendError(ctx, errors.New("service error"))
	}
	value := *p.Value + ":notification"
	if err := stream.SendNotification(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	value = *p.Value + ":response"
	return stream.SendResponse(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
}

func (s *fakeStream) SendNotification(ctx context.Context, _ *svc.WatchResult) error {
	s.ctx, s.operation = ctx, "notification"
	return s.err
}

func (s *fakeStream) SendResponse(ctx context.Context, _ *svc.WatchResult) error {
	s.ctx, s.operation = ctx, "response"
	return s.err
}

func (s *fakeStream) SendError(ctx context.Context, _ error) error {
	s.ctx, s.operation = ctx, "error"
	return s.err
}

func (s *fakeStream) Close() error {
	s.operation = "close"
	return s.err
}
